note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All, Reports.Read.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Organization.Read.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)

$grp = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Intune Users'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $grp) { $grp = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = 'MG Lab - Intune Users'; mailNickname = 'mglab-intune-users'; mailEnabled = $false; securityEnabled = $true; 'members@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$(Get-LabUserId 'alex.demo')", "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$(Get-LabUserId 'sam.demo')") } }
./src/Invoke-AppsDeploy.ps1 -BuildXml; ./src/Invoke-AppsDeploy.ps1 -ValidateXml   # off-camera dry run on the host
# VM CON-W11-01: start, checkpoint, copy src, the Office Deployment Tool and PowerShell 7 (installed in the VM in the first step of the install screen)

if ((Get-VM -Name CON-W11-01).State -ne 'Running') { Start-VM -Name CON-W11-01 }; Enable-VMIntegrationService -VMName CON-W11-01 -Name 'Guest Service Interface'; Checkpoint-VM -Name CON-W11-01 -SnapshotName pre-mglab-ep13

$zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep13-src.zip'; Remove-Item $zip -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Compress-Archive -Path ./src/* -DestinationPath $zip; Copy-VMFile -VMName CON-W11-01 -SourcePath $zip -DestinationPath C:\mg\ -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force

$odt = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-odt'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $odt | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest 'https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkID=626065' -OutFile (Join-Path $odt 'odt.exe'); Start-Process (Join-Path $odt 'odt.exe') "/quiet /extract:$odt" -Wait; Copy-VMFile -VMName CON-W11-01 -SourcePath (Join-Path $odt 'setup.exe') -DestinationPath C:\ODT\ -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force

$v = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); $msi = Join-Path $env:TEMP "PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi"; if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-VMFile -VMName CON-W11-01 -SourcePath $msi -DestinationPath C:\mg\pwsh.msi -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force

screens.name: install
screens.app: VMConnect to CON-W11-01, elevated PowerShell 7 as alex.demo, then Word
steps: In the VM (elevated Windows PowerShell): Start-Process msiexec.exe '/i C:\mg\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1' -Wait; Expand-Archive C:\mg\mglab-ep13-src.zip C:\mg\src -Force (off camera), then open elevated PowerShell 7 and cd C:\mg\src
Type: ./Invoke-AppsDeploy.ps1 -Install -OdtPath C:\ODT\setup.exe -WhatIf   (Result WhatIf: the command and the configuration file)

Type: ./Invoke-AppsDeploy.ps1 -Install -OdtPath C:\ODT\setup.exe -Confirm:$false   (real install, several minutes; wait for 'Products configured successfully' as printed; if it is not printed, read the logs in %temp% and say what really happened)
Open Word, sign in as alex.demo if asked: File > Account shows the user, 'Product Activated' and the update channel as it really is

screens.name: publish

steps: Intune admin center > Apps > Windows > 'MG Lab - Microsoft 365 Apps (Monthly Enterprise)'
Properties: channel, architecture, languages, excluded apps; Assignments: MG Lab - Intune Users, Required
If Graph rejected a property in the terminal, show the real error instead and fix the module

screens.note: Do not assign this app to the VM group while Office is already installed by the ODT unless you want to record what Intune really does with an existing install.

screens.name: inventory
steps: Type: cd C:\mg\src; ./Invoke-AppsDeploy.ps1 -Inventory   (property list and findings table exactly as they are; likely no findings on a fresh install)
Optional side by side: regedit at HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Inventory\Office\16.0 and ...\ClickToRun\Configuration
Do not invent findings; a real one can be shown by setting 'officeClientEdition' to 32 in the VM's apps.json and running -Inventory again (ArchitectureMismatch), then setting it back

screens.name: activation
screens.note: alex.demo appears once the activations report has refreshed after the VM activation (delay not documented): record the next day if he is missing. If names are concealed, say so (admin center > Settings > Org settings > Reports).

teardown: foreach ($a in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/beta/deviceAppManagement/mobileApps?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Microsoft 365 Apps (Monthly Enterprise)'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/beta/deviceAppManagement/mobileApps/$($a.id)" }
Restore-VMCheckpoint -VMName CON-W11-01 -Name pre-mglab-ep13 -Confirm:$false; Remove-VMCheckpoint -VMName CON-W11-01 -Name pre-mglab-ep13   # removes Microsoft 365 Apps, C:\ODT and C:\mg from the VM

foreach ($g in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'MG Lab - Intune Users'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)" }   # skip if episode 7 still needs it
needs: vm:CON-W11-01 (Windows 11, Entra joined as alex.demo, Intune enrolled, from episode 7)
licence:Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise enabled on alex.demo (E5 trial)
internet:VM reaches officecdn.microsoft.com and the Microsoft 365 sign-in endpoints
wait:activation report refresh (record the activation screen the next day if needed)
